cues.text: Hastily you lock the laboratory door with the key from Mylgor's study and,
to your relief, hear the huge special lock
close with a soft click - not a second too soon:
at the very moment you turn the key,
a terrible explosion in the laboratory shakes the whole house to its foundations -
but luckily the massive and wisely locked door keeps the worst of the blast away from you!
Plaster trickles from the ceiling, the floor and the walls tremble threateningly -
and suddenly everything goes very quiet:
only the crackling of the flames licking at the laboratory door can still be heard...
When the dust has settled after a while,
you look around: the laboratory door is still locked -
only black smoke is seeping out of small cracks in its frame...
You send a prayer of thanks to heaven for having survived the explosion unharmed -
in stark contrast to Mylgor, by the way,
who is now probably spread more or less evenly over the entire laboratory...
